data.content: Check product availability, if not exist, create order.
Check the parking lot; if there are no spaces available, put the person in line.
If it rains, the ground becomes wet.
If an employee works more than 40 hours in a week, they receive overtime pay.
Orders above 1000 need manager approval, orders above 100 need team lead approval, the rest are approved automatically.
Find the customer by email. If there is no customer, reject the request with CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, otherwise return the customer.
For every open ticket, send a reminder to its assignee.
The invoice total is the subtotal plus 18 percent tax.
A user's password must be at least 8 characters.
